gloss: getting along in the world; social survival

definitions.gloss: getting along in the world; social survival; navigating life in society
definitions.explanation: The art or skill of living successfully in society, dealing with people, and navigating social situations. Often implies practical wisdom about human relationships.

examples.japanese: {処世|しょせい}{術|じゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: To acquire the art of getting along in the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{処世|しょせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: She is a person who is good at navigating social life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{処世|しょせい}{訓|くん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧「⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧な」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}っていた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: My father often used to say 'don't make enemies' as his advice for getting along in the world.

notes:
Composed of {処|しょ} (deal with, manage) + {世|せい} (the world, society). Most commonly encountered in the compound {処世|しょせい}{術|じゅつ} (the art of getting along in the world). The concept emphasizes practical social wisdom — knowing how to deal with people, when to compromise, and how to avoid unnecessary conflict.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {処世|しょせい}{術|じゅつ}: art of worldly wisdom, social skills
- {処世|しょせい}{訓|くん}: maxim for living, life advice
- {処世|しょせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧: good at social navigation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{世渡|よわた}り→世渡り：07736_yowatari⟧: getting by in life — a more everyday term for the same concept
- ⟦{社交|しゃこう}→社交：13742_shakou⟧⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧: social skills — specifically about interpersonal communication
- ⟦{人付|ひとづ}き{合|あ}い→人付き合い：15516_hitozukiai⟧: social relations — dealings with other people in general
